anchor_value: USD-denominated fair value in the filing schedule
rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency='U_USD' as not USD. The raw schedule's Fair Value column is dollar-denominated: a plain USD loan shows a dollar-marked fair value of 32,734, and a CAD par loan shows fair value 42,696 with only the CAD equivalent parenthesized. The source therefore supports the extracted fair values as USD-denominated; the check appears to be rejecting the unit label U_USD rather than exposing a data error.
